questions.q: How many Lagaakhar are there in Gurmukhi?
questions.exp: There are three Lagaakhar: Bindi, Tippi, and Adhak.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a Lagaakhar?
questions.exp: Sihari is a Lagaan (vowel symbol), not a Lagaakhar.

questions.q: Bindi is used with how many Lagaan?
Which symbol is used to represent a stressed or doubled consonant sound?
questions.exp: Adhak is used to double the sound of the following consonant.

questions.q: Tippi is used with which of the following Lagaan?
questions.exp: Tippi is used with Mukta, Sihari, Aunkar, and Dulankar.
Kanna takes a Bindi, so ਗਾਂ is correct.

questions.q: Which is the correct spelling for 'color'?
questions.exp: Mukta takes a Tippi for nasal sound, so ਰੰਗ is correct.
Adhak is generally used with Mukta, Sihari, and Aunkar.
